sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate now faithfully encodes the scoped frame applicability, permitted supporting-structure alternatives, conditional intermediate-frame horizontal-member alternative, explicit adjacent-main-frame linkage, and frame-owned strengthening, lower-limit, and scantlings evidence. Deterministic validation is valid and no further repair is required.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the applicability and alternative logic. The unconditional sh:minCount constraints on the frame target over-apply the requirement to every frame; constrain existence and lower-end checks to mainFrame or intermediateIceFrame strengthened parts only, and enforce the lower-end condition for each such part. The attachment branch currently accepts any hasAttachedSupportingStructure value, but the requirement permits only a deck, tank top or tank-boundary plating, or ice stringer; require the corresponding canonical types (including the tank top/bottom plating alternatives) rather than generic supportingStructure presence. The horizontal-member alternative must be conditional on an intermediateIceFrame terminating below the permitted supporting structure, not on any main or intermediate frame, and must bind that permitted structure and the adjacent mainFrame explicitly. Preserve the separate main-frame ice-strengthening check.

Continue the prior repair, but correct the remaining owner and conditional-linkage errors. The main-frame strengthening flag is checked on ?mainPart even though mainFrameBelowIceBeltStrengthened has requiredOwner frame; check it on the supplied frame owner ($this), not on the strengthened-part node. Likewise, bind the horizontal-member alternative to the same intermediate frame, lower end, permitted supporting structure, adjacent main frame, and member, and place supportingStructureAtOrBelowIceBeltLowerLimit and sameScantlingsAsMainFrame on their declared frame owner rather than using booleans on an unrelated intermediate node. The current FILTER NOT EXISTS over one large conjunction can allow an incorrectly linked alternative through; express each represented horizontal member as requiring the complete conditional evidence, with the permitted support type and the adjacent main-frame relationship explicitly linked. Preserve the scoped mainFrame/intermediateIceFrame applicability and the four permitted supporting-structure alternatives.

The candidate now faithfully encodes the scoped frame applicability, permitted supporting-structure alternatives, conditional intermediate-frame horizontal-member alternative, explicit adjacent-main-frame linkage, and frame-owned strengthening, lower-limit, and scantlings evidence. Deterministic validation is valid and no further repair is required.
